name: OneDrive / SharePoint shared-file sign-in (capture + awareness redirect)
description: Authorised-simulation OneDrive / SharePoint 'someone shared a file with you' page for sharepoint.texti1color.ch: a OneDrive share banner + file chip ('Detlef Fischer hat eine Datei mit Ihnen geteilt' — Strategie_2026_Schoeller_Integration.xlsx) above the standard Microsoft sign-in card. Records email + password + OTP to the tracker (3-step concept — click recorded by the tracker visit, credentials recorded on submit), then redirects to a built-in 'Ooops, du wurdest gephisht' awareness page (learn.html) instead of the real Microsoft login. Captures are stored in plaintext server-side — use only where the engagement consent covers credential capture, and purge after the programme.
